items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I used to give work to every kid right there. Sometimes I had two, three jobs, I used to give them jobs on the side. Wooden Joe worked with me too a while. He worked with me on the last at Moreau.

ctx.x: You usually had your own band then?

Oh yeah, I mostly worked by myself, mostly all the time. I had plenty of work at that time. I used to give work to every kid right there. Sometimes I had two, three jobs, I used to give them jobs on the side. Wooden Joe worked with me too a while. He worked with me on the last at Moreau. He was the last one worked with me at Moreau. Wooden Joe, Lawrence Morari, and Eddie Johnson. Eddie Johnson was a sacrifice. That was the last one when the place closed. They had added.
